egress.terms: Each slice adds 2TB transfer next to 1TB SATA storage, a 2:1 ratio; 10 slices carry 20TB transfer. The page states no transfer period and no overage rate.
egress.free_allowance: 2TB per slice; 20TB at 10 slices; period unstated on the page

interface_detail: root SSH access in a Linux CLI environment; transfer by rsync over SSH, SFTP, SCP or FTP over TLS
chaining: Backup and archive target over rsync over SSH, SFTP, SCP or FTP over TLS; storage slices can be added at any time.
limits_note: Slice count adds RAM and cores linearly, which is wasted spend for pure storage. 10 Gbps shared port. The traffic ratio is the binding constraint, not the price.
reliability_note: Long-established US host (Secaucus/LA). The $3/TB headline is genuine and linear — 10 slices is $30 for 10 TB, no discount, no cliff. Page served a 403 to the read broker and was retrieved via the provider renderer.

extras.agent_focus: Cheapest per-TB-month storage VPS and Storage Boxes in Europe. Price floor hunt with egress as the deciding term. Tiers recorded at 1TB/5TB/10TB/20TB. Excludes AWS/Azure/GCP/Alibaba/R2/B2/iDrive e2 per client instruction.
